claim_boundaries.aabb_envelopes_only: The projected rectangles bound retained axis-aligned boxes derived from world.get_bbox corner minima/maxima. They are not OBBs, exact meshes, silhouettes, segmentation masks, image footprints or object pixels.
claim_boundaries.no_measurement_or_endpoint_inference: No RGB artifact, crop/time mapping, labelability, human annotation, measurement feasibility, r0/rhat/r endpoint or generated/executed correspondence is authenticated. No A1-A9 result follows.
claim_boundaries.no_visibility_or_occlusion_inference: Rectangle overlap does not prove silhouette overlap or occlusion; rectangle separation does not prove object visibility. Camera-z order does not identify a visible front object. The robot, static scene, RGB content and general ray/surface occlusion are not analyzed.
claim_boundaries.science_and_release: No scientific acceptance threshold, fixture/camera qualification, current-state inference, gate promotion, dispatch/release authority or new behavioral evidence follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_and_effects: The six reset mappings are availability-selected from seven prior-authenticated cells and are not a representative or full cohort. No layout, command, model, task-success or population effect is estimated, and the per-camera descriptors do not define a camera ranking.

finding: Across six availability-selected unique reset mappings, four cameras and three retained-object pairs, 39 of 72 projected AABB-envelope pairs have positive rectangle-overlap area and 33 have positive rectangle separation; none only touch. Camera-z intervals overlap for 50 pairs and are strictly ordered for 22; none only touch. These are axis-aligned retained-geometry descriptors, not observed-object or visibility evidence.

predicate_semantics.camera_depth_intervals: Camera z is computed for the same eight AABB corners. One AABB is strictly nearer in camera z only when its maximum z is below the other AABB's minimum z; otherwise intervals overlap or touch. Camera z is not Euclidean range and this order is not a visibility result.
predicate_semantics.inherited_method_label_boundary: The retained label calibrated_projection_and_obb_occlusion fronts a per-axis min/max AABB and target-center-ray-only implementation. This audit does not reinterpret that label as OBB or general occlusion.
predicate_semantics.projected_envelopes: For each retained world.get_bbox-derived robot-base AABB, project its eight corners with the pinned camera formula and take independent u/v minima and maxima. Pairwise positive-area rectangle overlap, positive rectangle separation or exact boundary touch is then computed without an epsilon or scientific threshold.
